title: PregOutfit 솔로 #102 · 임산부슈퍼글래머 · 흰 새틴 스트링 삼각 비키니 · moist rose-tinted lips
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Chinese woman, an adult, in her late 20s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Her face is a real living adult face, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real pores, real living eyes, 200 clicker rings piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal earrings. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme glossy white satin extreme platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
